name: Saku
source:
[i]"Saku is an archivist, remember? While my sources must remain secret, there is nothing in Itehari that escapes my notice!"[/i]

A young and elusive archivist. His information doesn't come cheap, but his skills are the real deal, and is known to be calculating and worldly.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
